name: doodle
font: 'Doodle Hand', 'Patrick Hand', 'Bradley Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive
_note: Text-only marker-on-white theme copied from a reference carousel. No kicker labels (the template skips them for this style), no photos or backgrounds (slide images are not rendered), no palette: every page is the same pure white. Fonts are bundled in config/fonts/doodle (SIL OFL) so rendering never needs the network.
